size_rating.boundary_rule: size_mm >= lower_bound enters the higher star
size_rating.note_zh: 本物种内的体型等级；非物种稀有度或操作评分。整数毫米导致小型种各档概率略有偏差。

sprite_size_scaling.note_zh: 所有鱼用共同的压缩尺寸尺度；以实际透明轮廓缩放，不按各物种最大体型归一化。TL/CL/CW口径保留；上限适配卡面。

fishing_rules.source_note_zh: 体型—重量采用立方锚点游戏估算；浮漂模式和搏鱼参数为玩法设定，并非物种识别/垂钓指导。
fishing_rules.distance_unit_note_zh: 相对距离单位，不是厘米或米；起始距离10000，物理比例后续随水下空间确定。
fishing_rules.tension_rise_per_100ms: active burst: clamp(2+floor(response_pull/20),2,7); active rest:2; calm:1
fishing_rules.line_response_model: min(cap, base_percent + floor(max(0, weight_g - comfortable_weight_g) * overweight_gain / comfortable_weight_g))
fishing_rules.landing_rule: reel_units == 10000; no stamina or time gate at any remaining distance
fishing_rules.strike_model: species delay + (species bite end - delay) * line window percent; early/late fail
fishing_rules.giant_force_extra: above 20000 g: +1 base force per 2000 g, capped +30; fatigues normally; final pull cap 140
fishing_rules.large_fish_run_extra: above 6500 g: +1 run unit per 2500 g excess, capped +8, then species multiplier
fishing_rules.slow_heavy_pressure: above 6500 g: tension rise clamp(1+response_pull/35,2,5) per 100ms
fishing_rules.predator_traits: species hook-pressure percent, species burst force-cap headroom; no instant overload on strike

catch_comments.editable_field: Markdown table third column; synchronized to species[].catch_comment_zh

rarity.note_zh: 刷新率指鱼种出现概率；当前一次抛竿抽取一次，不引入游鱼刷新计时。画面仍60FPS。

activity_model.transition: linear hourly ramps; dawn05-07 and dusk18-20; minimum nonzero eligible weight=1
activity_model.note: Gameplay tuning only. Mandarin fish has no night preference: day and night both100%, dawn/dusk115%. Other species keep distinct activity phases. Not a field survey.
